scientific_integrity: All infinite conclusions are proved algebraically; numerical enumeration is corroborative only. The rank-one and rank-two Fourier sums are previously known and are not claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: Only ambient additive constant-plus-one-coordinate characters on uniform GL_n; arbitrary erasures, higher-coordinate Fourier bands and nonabelian group Fourier transforms are not included. Historical equivalent formulations may exist; independent validation not performed.
title: A sharp \(n=2q\) spectral crossover for coordinate Fourier sampling on invertible finite-field matrices
